extension.description: A visual Markdown editor for VS Code. Edit tables, math and Mermaid diagrams while keeping portable Markdown source.
config.contentWidth: Maximum editor content width in pixels. 0 fills the window.
config.themeMode: Editor theme: auto (follow VS Code), light, or dark.
config.themeAuto: Follow the VS Code color theme automatically.
config.themeLight: Always use the light editor theme.
config.themeDark: Always use the dark editor theme.
config.previewDelay: Idle delay before refreshing the optional split preview, in milliseconds.
config.tableCells: Maximum number of table cells rendered as editable controls before falling back to source editing.
config.checkLinks: Check local file, image, and heading links after editing. Results appear in Problems.
config.updateLinks: Review incoming and outgoing Markdown link updates when files or folders are renamed in a trusted workspace.
config.templates: Custom document templates. Use {{title}} and {{date}} placeholders.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Editing and preview remain available. Workspace-controlled image destination and security settings are disabled.
config.defaultKeybindings: Use Markda's keyboard shortcuts while its editor is active. Off by default so VS Code shortcuts take priority.
config.fontFamily: Document font family. Leave empty to use the selected theme.
config.paragraphSpacing: Additional spacing between Markdown source lines, in em.
config.pdfBrowserPath: Path to Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, or Chromium for PDF export. Leave empty to search PATH and common system and per-user application locations.
config.pdfMarginMm: Page margin in millimeters for PDF export.
config.imageWidth: Width in pixels for PNG image export.
config.imageFontSize: Font size in pixels for PNG image export.
config.exportTargetExtension: Output extension such as docx. Leave empty for commands without an output file.
welcome.backlinks:
Documents linking to the current file appear here.
